At10% actual/360 on unchanged principal fromJanuary11,249 elapsed days gives$154,449.65 ($620.35 below claim);250date labels gives$155,069.93 ($0.07 below claim). Counting both endpoints and either final whole-dollar rounding or intermediate daily cent rounding can reproduce$155,070. The supplied records do not select those inclusion/rounding conventions or contain the claimant worksheet. If the asserted base includes September17, adding separately requested default interest from that date would require a nonoverlapping boundary explanation; the claimant methodology is missing.
